---
title: "PHASE paired-package validation"
format:
  html: default
  docx: default
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(islhepi)
library(islhr)
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()
islh_setup(format = if (is_html) "html" else "docx", embed_fonts = FALSE)
# Synthetic daily data with known, complete coverage; no patient information.
events <- data.frame(day = rep(as.Date("2026-06-01") + 0:41, c(rep(2, 35), rep(3, 7))))
daily <- islh_count_events(events, day, from = "2026-06-01", to = "2026-07-12")
weekly <- islh_count_events(daily, period_start, count = count, interval = "week")
baseline <- islh_surveillance_baseline(weekly[1:5, ], period_start, count)
snapshot <- islh_surveillance_snapshot(daily, period_start, count,
  end = "2026-07-12", baseline = baseline)
stopifnot(snapshot$total == 21, snapshot$exceeds_reference, snapshot$complete)
islh_epi_curve(daily, period_start, count)
if (is_html) islh_gt(snapshot, embed_fonts = FALSE) else islh_flextable(snapshot)
```

These are descriptive reference limits, using five complete Monday-start weeks.
The current window has 21 events against a historical weekly count of 14.

```{r}
# Preserve a semantic warning through branding, including in a long Word table.
tab <- data.frame(group = paste("Synthetic group with a long label", 1:70),
  status = rep(c("Review", "Routine"), 35))
if (is_html) {
  islh_gt(tab, embed_fonts = FALSE)
} else {
  ft <- flextable::flextable(tab)
  ft <- flextable::bg(ft, i = seq(1, 69, 2), bg = "yellow", part = "body")
  islh_flextable(ft)
}
```

```{r}
# Branding leaves summary choices explicit.
summary <- gtsummary::tbl_summary(data.frame(
  group = rep(c("A", "B"), 10), value = c(NA, 2:20)),
  by = group, statistic = list(gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})"),
  missing_text = "Not recorded")
if (is_html) islh_gtsummary_gt(summary, embed_fonts = FALSE) else islh_gtsummary_flex(summary)
```
